## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short one-fascicle liturgical-homage text by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the 37 Vajradhātu deities — companion to [KR6j0045](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0045) (the *lǐchàn wén*). Where [KR6j0045](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0045) is a full penitential liturgy with confession-and-homage components, [KR6j0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0046) is a focused **homage-only liturgy** (*lǐ* 禮) — a shorter daily devotional text addressed sequentially to the 37 deities.

**Abstract**

The *Sānshíqīzūn lǐ* gives a sequential homage-formula for the 37 Vajradhātu deities — the practitioner makes prostration to each deity in turn, with the deity's epithet, *bīja*, and brief invocation. The text is the shortest of the Vajradhātu liturgical compositions and was used as a portable daily-devotion text alongside the longer [KR6j0045](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0045) *lǐchàn*.

The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Chángān period (746–774). The text became a standard daily-practice text in Japanese Shingon and Tendai-Esoteric traditions.
